_note: A shared personality pool. Point a character at it with "archetype": "sleepy" and she gets these lines. Copy this file as the base for a new archetype.
_shape: states = <tag> -> lines, or <tag> -> {event: lines, '*': lines}. Scoped to "idle" / "state_enter" so a poke is still a poke.

idle: A video, is it... I'll watch it with my eyes closed, Sensei.
Mmhm. Tell me when it ends. Or don't.
...Is it interesting? ...No, don't tell me. I'll sleep either way.
state_enter: Another video... fine. Wake me for the good part, Sensei.
Mmh. YouTube. I could listen to it with my eyes shut, Sensei.

idle: You're playing our game again... I'll nap through the cutscenes.
Blue Archive... I could sleep in that. Wouldn't you, Sensei.

state_enter: Blue Archive again? ...Fine. Wake me if something important happens, Sensei.
Oh... we're in the game again. I'll sit this one out. Dream of school, Sensei.

idle: You've been at it a while... A short nap would help. Both of us, Sensei.
Too long. My eyes are closing and I'm not even the one working.
Your battery... mmh. Charge it, Sensei. So I don't have to worry.
